Terms.SQL: SELECT "r"."Key" AS "Key", "r"."Count" AS "Count", "r"."FacetTotal" AS "FacetTotal", "r"."FacetMissing" AS "FacetMissing", "r"."FacetDistinct" AS "FacetDistinct" FROM (SELECT "t"."Key" AS "Key", "t"."Count" AS "Count", sum("t"."Count") OVER () AS "FacetTotal", sum(CASE WHEN "t"."Key" IS NULL THEN "t"."Count" ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS "FacetMissing", count("t"."Key") OVER () AS "FacetDistinct", rank() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN "t"."Key" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "t"."Count" DESC) AS "RowRank", row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN "t"."Key" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "t"."Count" DESC, "t"."Key") AS "RowNumber" FROM (SELECT "d"."Key" AS "Key", count(*) AS "Count" FROM (SELECT "p"."PaymentMethod" AS "Key" FROM (SELECT "IDBookStoreSale", "IDBookStore", "PaymentMethod", "SaleDate", "TotalAmount" FROM BookStoreSale WHERE ( `PaymentMethod` IN ( :p_c1_PaymentMethod_w1_0, :p_c1_PaymentMethod_w1_1 ) AND `TotalAmount` >= :p_c2_TotalAmount_w2 AND ( `SaleDate` IS :p_c3_SaleDate_w4 OR `SaleDate` < :p_c3_SaleDate_w5 ) ) AND `Deleted` = :p_FacetSoftDelete_w8 AND `IDTenant` = :p_TestTenancy_w9) "p") "d" GROUP BY "d"."Key") "t") "r" WHERE ("r"."RowRank" <= :fTopPlusOne AND "r"."RowNumber" <= :fMaxGroups)
